# familiar

<!-- ops:identity start — generated by ops-docs; edit identity.toml -->
*Agent pets and the session hook bus*

Gives each coding-agent session a pet that reacts to its lifecycle in the terminal,
the agent's status line or pet picker, and the desktop. The engine observes session
events dispatched by relay and renders a member of an installed theme chosen by
project and role; themes and their art install separately.

Authority: `docs/surfaces.md`, `docs/install.md`, `docs/attention.md`, `docs/terminal-rendering.md`

## Install

Requires Node.js 22+ and Git 2.31+, and [relay](https://github.com/khughitt/relay),
which owns lifecycle hooks; Familiar observes its events.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/khughitt/familiar.git
cd familiar
npm install
npm link
familiar scheme set dark
familiar theme add <theme-url-or-directory>
```

Set `theme: <installed-id>` in `~/.config/familiar/config.yaml` (preserve other
settings), then run `familiar whoami`. Installing a pack does not select it.
Complete relay and harness setup in the installation guide below.

Linux and macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon — see [surfaces](docs/surfaces.md) for what each platform claims.
[Installation and integration setup](docs/install.md) covers each agent and desktop.

## Usage

Themes install separately with `familiar theme add`; this repository ships no art. A
theme is a cast of roles plus an optional world; a project's family picks the theme and
the session's `FAMILIAR_ROLE` picks the member
([family, role and world](docs/configuration.md#family-role-and-world)).

`familiar --help` lists every command; `familiar <command> --help` and
`familiar theme list --help` (nested help works the same way) print a command's
own usage, and `familiar help <command>...` is the same thing spelled as a verb.
`-V`/`--version` prints the installed version.

`--json`/`--pretty` (mutually exclusive, `FAMILIAR_FORMAT` overrides the
default) and `--color auto|always|never` (default `never`, `FAMILIAR_COLOR`
overrides it) work before or after the command. A usage error — an unknown
command, a missing argument, a value outside its set — exits 2; a command that
ran and failed exits 1, printing `{"error":{"kind","detail"}}` on stderr under
`--json`.

Shell completion: `eval "$(FAMILIAR_COMPLETE=zsh familiar)"` (or `bash` for the
bash completer), sourced from your shell's rc file.

## Configuration

Lifecycle hooks are owned by relay; `familiar setup relay` prints its observer entries.
See [relay and harness setup](docs/install.md#relay-and-harness-setup).
Themes install under ~/.config/familiar/themes/, and ~/.config/familiar/config.yaml
names the default theme and maps families to themes. See [configuration](docs/configuration.md).

## Layout

- `bin/`: the `familiar` CLI and the Niri, Noctalia and OpenCode entry points.
- `src/`: the engine: observation, theme loading, animation and rendering.
- `integrations/`: Niri, Noctalia and OpenCode plugins.
- `test/`: the suite; `tools/test-runner.mjs` runs it.
- `tools/`: test and gate helpers, plus tooling vendored from
  [ops](https://github.com/khughitt/ops) (see [tools/README.md](tools/README.md)).

## Development

The test suite requires [just](https://just.systems).
Use `just test-one test/test-runner.test.js` while working on explicit modules.
`just test-fast` selects the fast partition; `just test` selects fast and slow.
Both broad recipes skip automatically under `.tt.toml`; `just test-full` deliberately
forces the full suite. `just check` always runs mandatory hygiene. The npm scripts
are the underlying partition commands, and the slow set covers attention, relay,
tmux pty and Noctalia cadence.
The hosted workflow explicitly forces both Linux full-suite jobs, Mac fast/linked
checks and the Linux install smoke on origin branch/tag pushes. Internal PRs avoid
duplicate suites, while fork PRs keep verification. Cancellation is not a passing
result. See [testing](docs/testing.md) for commands, coverage limits, timing and
rollback.
The runner gives workers a temporary home and explicit environment, with host Git
configuration and hook redirections excluded. Tests set any other needed variables.
On macOS, run them with `TMPDIR=/tmp`: the per-user temporary directory is too long
for the suite's Unix-socket fixtures, and the runner refuses it.
